ValidationRule.description: If Status is not Issued but Voided, issued but voided date should not be changed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISPICKVAL( Coupon_Status__c, "Issued but Voided" )) && ISCHANGED( Coupon_Issued_but_Voided_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Coupon Issued but Voided Date can only be set when setting the Coupon Status to Issued but Voided
